_comment: Gates of the streaming quality gate (tools/stream-gate), made by tools/stream-gate/make_gates.py from each baseline (baseline-stage4-<lane>.json, main db5978d, SFU 7e97d4a) and one --repeat 3 run of every profile on the same commit and machine: four runs per lane. Where the gate made from the 2.1 baseline was tighter, that bound is kept (a gate never loosens); the exceptions are the hardware clean, outage and late-join VMAF floors, whose 2.1 values came from runs at 20 to 35 fps that VMAF scores too high. A floor or ceiling is the baseline value minus or plus the largest of a fixed margin, a share of the value and 1.1 x the spread of the nine runs. A metric missing in any run (no frame presented) has no gate. A run fails when VMAF drops by more than vmaf_max_drop (1 point) against the baseline on a profile with a VMAF floor, or by more than the profile's measured spread where that spread is larger (vmaf_max_drop_profile); when freeze time rises by more than the profile's spread (freeze_ms_max_rise); or when a gate below fails. A profile outside a gate runs twice more and the gates read the median of its three runs. _spread keeps the values of each gated metric. Gates may tighten when a stage improves a profile; they never loosen.
